items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: I went in as the music director and had charge of the small band that played the dance music between shows. And I was so -- music director for the show -- the band that Claude Hopkins played in.

ctx.x: Although there were performances, dozens of times (inaudible).

Sampson did a lot -- There was a lot of things that Sampson did. Sampson was one of the most important arrangers. You know, let's talk about Edgar Sampson and the arrangements. When I joined the band in 1936, I always knew -- I knew Chick -- I played a couple of little gigs with him before I joined the band -- before I left town, when I was hanging out with him years ago -- '33-'34--something like that. He was just getting his band together. I think why I had -- I think why I did play a couple of gigs with him,…
